items.title: 9.4 Developing Effective Marketing and Sales Strategies

source_refs.note: Topic 9.4 (PDF 216, printed 213). MCQ 7 (b) matches the key.

blocks.text: Marketing and sales help businesses attract customers, increase sales and grow their brand. This section develops marketing and sales strategies with examples from Pakistan.

blocks.prompt: What is a key component of effective marketing (MCQ 7)?

items: Marketing and sales attract customers, raise sales and build the brand.
